resolved_review_observations: After adding the real paired Station dependency for the legacy tests, build.py was updated to reproduce the same native_station_test_dependency metadata and installer information hash. No catalog or runtime change was required.
checks: Only five templates change: realization_payment_lines, totals, days, items and items_days. Each version1 becomes2, retains every existing note and appends the same field-mapping note plus a calculation_contract. Other81 templates and all top-level catalog metadata remain unchanged.

All source operations, requests, steps, columns, output stages, queries, grouping and arithmetic remain unchanged. Each contract declares its own original group_by and dataset_query. Patch objects equal the full changed templates.

All three source recipe fingerprints and the common dataset query catalog hash match local canonical registered sources. Positive realization targets require non-null commission and positive raw commission.sale_amount; canonical quantity, identity, sign and currency validation are retained.

Canonical buyer sale_amount maps from raw commission.sale_price.amount; canonical seller_amount maps from raw commission.sale_amount.amount. Both are already whole-line amounts. The contract forbids replacing buyer money with seller money or multiplying line amounts by quantity again.

sale_units uses target quantity. Grouped average_price is sum of buyer amounts divided by sum of quantities, not an unweighted row average or seller measure. Single-line buyer_unit_average preserves the multi-item-line limitation.

Posting join uses accrual unit_number versus posting posting_number and the canonical strict SKU identity. Missing/empty target posting becomes null. Both FBO/FBS metadata sources use the registered bounded from-minus31-days through-to history in nonoverlapping inclusive31-day chunks.

Canonical relation rules reject duplicate right keys, parent-posting/SKU mismatch and matched quantity exceeding metadata capacity; they preserve selected target rows, units and both money measures. Payment labels remain literal; unmatched/unknown values remain separately unknown rather than no-card. Metadata completeness is distinct from enrichment coverage.

Accrual-date, complete-page and currency requirements remain. Missing/incomplete/error responses are not zero; valid explicit zero buyer money remains valid. No fiscal receipt or verified card-product mapping is claimed, and no expected answer or original-question rewrite is injected.
